```plato
//==
// # Matrix operations
//
// The portable reference bodies for `Matrix3x2` (2D affine) and `Matrix4x4`
// (3D homogeneous), covering determinant, inversion, arithmetic, decomposition,
// and the whole `Create*` construction family. These used to be bodiless
// intrinsics; the semantics here match System.Numerics `Matrix3x2` / `Matrix4x4`
// element for element, so a backend may substitute the native call.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Matrices (row-vector multiplication, v' = v M).
//
// Element naming follows the row-vector layout of `matrices.types.plato`: for
// Matrix3x2, M11 = Row1.X ... M32 = Row3.Y and Row3 is the translation; for
// Matrix4x4, M11 = Row1.X ... M44 = Row4.W and Row4 is the translation.
//
// Two deliberate deviations from the System.Numerics reference implementation:
//
//   * `Matrix3x2.CreateRotation` does NOT snap angles within a thousandth of a
//     degree of a multiple of a quarter turn to exact 0 / +-1 cosines. Plain
//     Cos / Sin are used instead: the snap is a C#-era numerical courtesy, not
//     part of the mathematical definition, and it costs a per-call
//     IEEERemainder plus four range tests on every backend.
//   * The projection and view constructors (`CreatePerspective*`,
//     `CreateOrthographic*`, `CreateLookAt`, `CreateWorld`) throw
//     ArgumentOutOfRangeException in C# for degenerate inputs. Plato has no
//     exceptions, so the preconditions stated in each doc comment are UNCHECKED:
//     violating one yields infinities or NaN rather than a diagnostic.

library MatricesOps
{
    //==
    // # Matrix3x2 — the 2D affine map
    //
    // Three Number2 rows: a 2x2 linear block (Row1, Row2) plus a translation row
    // (Row3). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Affine_transformation

    // The determinant of the 2x2 linear block: M11 M22 - M21 M12. The
    // translation row does not affect it.
    Determinant(self: Matrix3x2): Number
        => self.Row1.X * self.Row2.Y - self.Row2.X * self.Row1.Y;
```

## Line 166

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/matrices-ops.library.plato, line 166](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/matrices-ops.library.plato#L166).

```plato

    //==
    // # Matrix4x4 — the 3D homogeneous map
    //
    // Four Number4 rows: a 3x3 linear block plus a translation row (Row4) and a
    // projective column. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Transformation_matrix

    // The determinant, by the Laplace expansion along the first row with the six
    // 2x2 minors of the bottom two rows shared between the four cofactors.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Determinant
    Determinant(self: Matrix4x4): Number {
        var m11 = self.Row1.X; var m12 = self.Row1.Y; var m13 = self.Row1.Z; var m14 = self.Row1.W;
        var m21 = self.Row2.X; var m22 = self.Row2.Y; var m23 = self.Row2.Z; var m24 = self.Row2.W;
        var m31 = self.Row3.X; var m32 = self.Row3.Y; var m33 = self.Row3.Z; var m34 = self.Row3.W;
        var m41 = self.Row4.X; var m42 = self.Row4.Y; var m43 = self.Row4.Z; var m44 = self.Row4.W;
        var kpLo = m33 * m44 - m34 * m43;
        var jpLn = m32 * m44 - m34 * m42;
        var joKn = m32 * m43 - m33 * m42;
        var ipLm = m31 * m44 - m34 * m41;
        var ioKm = m31 * m43 - m33 * m41;
        var inJm = m31 * m42 - m32 * m41;
        return m11 * (m22 * kpLo - m23 * jpLn + m24 * joKn)
             - m12 * (m21 * kpLo - m23 * ipLm + m24 * ioKm)
             + m13 * (m21 * jpLn - m22 * ipLm + m24 * inJm)
             - m14 * (m21 * joKn - m22 * ioKm + m23 * inJm);
    }
```
